title: One Rational Matrix Hitting Point for Noncommutative Formulas
summary: We construct, in deterministic polynomial bit time, one tuple of rational matrices that detects every nonzero polynomial computed by a noncommutative division-free formula of a prescribed size. The matrices have dimension $`O(ns^2)`$ for n variables and formula size s , and the same tuple works over every field of characteristic zero.
family_title: Uniform black-box noncommutative identity testing across characteristics

review.reason: Constructs a rational matrix tuple detecting nonzero noncommutative formula polynomials in polynomial time.
